messages.subject: Re: Summary output looks different
parts:
Hm. That is not supposed to happen. (It works for me). But I did change
the way it works in 0.6-12.

First, I would reboot and try again. If you still see the 'list' output,
could you show us the output of:

1) sessionInfo()

2) (assuming that your fitted object is called 'fit'): class(fit)

# this should be 'lavaan'

3) out <- summary(fit); class(out)

# this should be "lavaan.summary" "list"

4) lavaan:::print.lavaan.summary(out)

# this should show the 'usual' output

Yves.

On 7/7/22 04:36, ali wrote:
> Summary() output used to look like this:
> lavaan-summary-old.jpg
> Today I reran summary() on a model and it looks like this now:
> lavaan-summary-new.jpg
>
> Any idea why it's showing it like this now?
>
> Thanks!
